rows.kind: his slip (stays as written unless it is our misreading)
rows.as_the_page_reads: a finite ordered set is a combinatorial simplex iff it is polyhedral, has a greatest element, and every non-minimal element has at least two predecessors; hence At pol 1 + At simp 1 define the simplicial ateliers
rows.should_read: add distributivity: S is P*(J) iff S with a bottom added is a distributive lattice satisfying At simp 1; At pol 1 + At simp 1 alone admit every polytopal (lattice) cell, the square first
rows.evidence: SA21-R7-06; G. Birkhoff, Lattice theory, 3rd ed., AMS 1967, ch. III (locator to be checked)
